import pytest
from decimal import Decimal
from piccolo.table import Table
from piccolo.columns.column_types import Array, Numeric
from piccolo.engine.sqlite import SQLiteEngine


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_bug():
    engine = SQLiteEngine(":memory:")

    class Prices(Table, db=engine):
        values = Array(Numeric(digits=(5, 2)))

    await Prices.create_table().run()

    await Prices({Prices.values: [Decimal("0.1")]}).save()
    row = await Prices.select(Prices.values).first()
